overview.startPoint: Speak to Almera in her house north-east of the Baxtorian Falls.

enemies.text: None, but you must be able to survive some attacks from various aggressive mobs, including skeletons (level 58)

blocks.caption: Path to get to Tree Gnome Village inside the maze

blocks.html: Talk to Almera inside her house, south of the Barbarian Outpost.
blocks.text: Talk to Almera inside her house, south of the Barbarian Outpost.

blocks.html: Board the raft to the west.
blocks.text: Board the raft to the west.

blocks.html: Talk to Hudon north of where you land.
blocks.text: Talk to Hudon north of where you land.

substeps.html: If you do not talk to Hudon you will not be able to find the Book on Baxtorian in the later step.
substeps.text: If you do not talk to Hudon you will not be able to find the Book on Baxtorian in the later step.

blocks.html: Click swim on the river to the south to end up back on shore.
blocks.text: Click swim on the river to the south to end up back on shore.

blocks.html: Once back on shore, head into the house to your north-west right next to where you arrived on shore and climb either the inside staircase, or the outside staircase on the south side of the larger building.
blocks.text: Once back on shore, head into the house to your north-west right next to where you arrived on shore and climb either the inside staircase, or the outside staircase on the south side of the larger building.

blocks.html: Search the southern bookcase on the east wall to find the Book on Baxtorian.
blocks.text: Search the southern bookcase on the east wall to find the Book on Baxtorian.

blocks.html: Head to the Tree Gnome Village, located north-west of Yanille.
blocks.text: Head to the Tree Gnome Village, located north-west of Yanille.

blocks.html: Once there, follow the path through the maze, heading towards the dungeon marked on the map
blocks.text: Once there, follow the path through the maze, heading towards the dungeon marked on the map

substeps.html: If the quest Tree Gnome Village is at least partially completed, follow Elkoy, who is at the beginning and end of the maze.
substeps.text: If the quest Tree Gnome Village is at least partially completed, follow Elkoy, who is at the beginning and end of the maze.

substeps.html: If the quest is not partially completed, it is recommended to squeeze through the loose railing and speak to King Bolren while nearby.
substeps.text: If the quest is not partially completed, it is recommended to squeeze through the loose railing and speak to King Bolren while nearby.

substeps.html: Go east and enter the dungeon.
substeps.text: Go east and enter the dungeon.

blocks.html: Inside the dungeon, go to the eastern room.
blocks.text: Inside the dungeon, go to the eastern room.

blocks.html: Search the south-east stack of crates which is a different colour than the others, to find a key (must read book in order to find key).
blocks.text: Search the south-east stack of crates which is a different colour than the others, to find a key (must read book in order to find key).

blocks.html: Head to the westernmost room and use the key on the gate to unlock it.
blocks.text: Head to the westernmost room and use the key on the gate to unlock it.

blocks.html: Enter and speak to Golrie to find Glarial's pebble.
blocks.text: Enter and speak to Golrie to find Glarial's pebble.

blocks.html: v • d • e
Bank everything except Glarial's pebble and your rope (you may bring food and allowed items).
blocks.text: Bank everything except Glarial's pebble and your rope (you may bring food and allowed items).

substeps.html: To enter the tomb, you cannot bring combat-related items such as weapons, armour, or runes.
substeps.text: To enter the tomb, you cannot bring combat-related items such as weapons, armour, or runes.

substeps.html: You may drop 6 air runes, 6 water runes and 6 earth runes outside the tomb and retrieve them upon exiting, in order to skip banking for the final part.
substeps.text: You may drop 6 air runes, 6 water runes and 6 earth runes outside the tomb and retrieve them upon exiting, in order to skip banking for the final part.

blocks.html: Teleport to Ardougne lodestone and go north-west of the Fishing Guild to find Glarial's tombstone.
blocks.text: Teleport to Ardougne lodestone and go north-west of the Fishing Guild to find Glarial's tombstone.

blocks.html: Use Glarial's pebble on the tombstone.
blocks.text: Use Glarial's pebble on the tombstone.

substeps.html: If it says It fits perfectly, but nothing happens., it's because you are wearing disallowed items or carrying runes
substeps.text: If it says It fits perfectly, but nothing happens., it's because you are wearing disallowed items or carrying runes

blocks.html: Go west and search the chest to obtain Glarial's amulet.
blocks.text: Go west and search the chest to obtain Glarial's amulet.

substeps.html: Optional: Drop the amulet and search the chest for a second one, preventing having to obtain a second one after the quest for dungeon access.
substeps.text: Optional: Drop the amulet and search the chest for a second one, preventing having to obtain a second one after the quest for dungeon access.

blocks.html: Go south and search Glarial's Tomb to obtain Glarial's urn.
blocks.text: Go south and search Glarial's Tomb to obtain Glarial's urn.

blocks.html: Head north-east back up the ladder you came down.
blocks.text: Head north-east back up the ladder you came down.

blocks.html: Combination runes such as dust and lava will not work.
Go north-west to the quest start point (Almera's house) and board the raft once more.
blocks.text: Go north-west to the quest start point (Almera's house) and board the raft once more.

blocks.html: Use your rope on the rock situated on the bank to the south (do not click 'swim to rock').
blocks.text: Use your rope on the rock situated on the bank to the south (do not click 'swim to rock').

blocks.html: Use your rope on the dead tree next to you (do not click 'climb tree').
blocks.text: Use your rope on the dead tree next to you (do not click 'climb tree').

blocks.html: With Glarial's amulet in your inventory, enter the cave door north.
blocks.text: With Glarial's amulet in your inventory, enter the cave door north.

blocks.html: Go north-east, open the door, and search the light-colored crates on the northern wall for another key.
blocks.text: Go north-east, open the door, and search the light-colored crates on the northern wall for another key.

blocks.html: Return to the centre room and go down the western passage, past the fire giants, through the doors north.
blocks.text: Return to the centre room and go down the western passage, past the fire giants, through the doors north.

blocks.html: Use the key on the last door.
blocks.text: Use the key on the last door.

blocks.html: Make sure you follow these three steps carefully or you will be washed up down stream.
blocks.text: Make sure you follow these three steps carefully or you will be washed up down stream.

substeps.html: Use an air rune, a water rune, and an earth rune on each of the six pillars.
substeps.text: Use an air rune, a water rune, and an earth rune on each of the six pillars.

substeps.html: Use Glarial's amulet on the statue of Glarial, the western statue.
substeps.text: Use Glarial's amulet on the statue of Glarial, the western statue.

substeps.html: Use Glarial's urn on the Chalice of Eternity, in the centre of the room.
substeps.text: Use Glarial's urn on the Chalice of Eternity, in the centre of the room.

substeps.html: If you attempt to take the Chalice you will be washed up down stream and will have to get the amulet back from the chest under Glarial's tombstone before being able to return to the cave.
substeps.text: If you attempt to take the Chalice you will be washed up down stream and will have to get the amulet back from the chest under Glarial's tombstone before being able to return to the cave.

items.html: Access to the Waterfall Dungeon for combat training. You must have Glarial's amulet in your inventory to re-enter the dungeon – attempting to enter without the amulet will result in the tunnel flooding with water, you getting washed into the river, ending up on the bank and taking some damage.
